rules.sentence: For these above-mentioned factors, multivariate analysis in binary logistic regression model was done and we found out that there was significant association (p<0.05) between the management outcomes of intestinal obstruction and 3 of them; these were length of hospital stay, previous history of abdominal surgery and previous history of intestinal obstruction (Table 6).
Factors associated with Management outcome of intestinal obstruction at AURH, Ethiopia, March 2021
